4. //==================================================================================================
5. // Imports
6. //==================================================================================================

8. use vstd::prelude::*;
9. #[cfg(verus_keep_ghost)]
10. include!("pde.spec.rs");
11. #[cfg(verus_keep_ghost)]
12. include!("pde.proof.rs");
13. 
14. use crate::{
15.     mem::paging::TableEntry,
16.     x86::mem::paging::{
17.         flags::{
18.             AccessedFlag,
19.             DirtyFlag,
20.             PageCacheDisableFlag,
21.             PageSizeFlag,
22.             PageWriteThroughFlag,
23.             PresentFlag,
24.             ReadWriteFlag,
25.             UserSupervisorFlag,
26.         },
27.         frame::FrameNumber,
28.         PteWord,
29.     },
30. };
31. 
32. //==================================================================================================
33. // Page Directory Entry Flags
34. //==================================================================================================
35. 
36. ///
37. /// # Description
38. ///
39. /// A type that represents flags of a page directory entry.
40. ///
41. #[verus_verify]
42. #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
43. pub struct PageDirectoryEntryFlags {
44.     /// Present flag.
45.     present: PresentFlag,
46.     /// Read/write flag.
47.     read_write: ReadWriteFlag,
48.     /// User/supervisor flag.
49.     user_supervisor: UserSupervisorFlag,
50.     /// Page write-through flag.
51.     page_write_through: PageWriteThroughFlag,
52.     /// Page cache disable flag.
53.     page_cache_disable: PageCacheDisableFlag,
54.     /// Accessed flag.
55.     accessed: AccessedFlag,
56.     /// Dirty flag.
57.     dirty: DirtyFlag,
58.     /// Page size flag (PDE-only, bit 7).
59.     page_size: PageSizeFlag,
60. }
61. 
62. impl PageDirectoryEntryFlags {
63.     ///
64.     /// # Description
65.     ///
66.     /// Constructs a [`PageDirectoryEntryFlags`] with the given flags.
67.     ///
68.     /// # Parameters
69.     ///
70.     /// - `present`: The present flag.
71.     /// - `read_write`: The read/write flag.
72.     /// - `user_supervisor`: The user/supervisor flag.
73.     /// - `page_write_through`: The page write-through flag.
74.     /// - `page_cache_disable`: The page cache disable flag.
75.     /// - `accessed`: The accessed flag.
76.     /// - `dirty`: The dirty flag.
77.     /// - `page_size`: The page size flag.
78.     ///
79.     /// # Returns
80.     ///
81.     /// A [`PageDirectoryEntryFlags`].
82.     ///
83.     #[cfg_attr(verus_keep_ghost, allow(unused, verus_impl_method_marker))]
84.     #[verus_spec(result =>
85.         ensures
86.             result@ == spec_pde_flags_new(
87.                 present,
88.                 read_write,
89.                 user_supervisor,
90.                 page_write_through,
91.                 page_cache_disable,
92.                 accessed,
93.                 dirty,
94.                 page_size,
95.             ),
96.     )]
97.     pub fn new(
98.         present: PresentFlag,
99.         read_write: ReadWriteFlag,
100.         user_supervisor: UserSupervisorFlag,
101.         page_write_through: PageWriteThroughFlag,
102.         page_cache_disable: PageCacheDisableFlag,
103.         accessed: AccessedFlag,
104.         dirty: DirtyFlag,
105.         page_size: PageSizeFlag,
106.     ) -> Self {
107.         Self {
108.             present,
109.             read_write,
110.             user_supervisor,
111.             page_write_through,
112.             page_cache_disable,
113.             accessed,
114.             dirty,
115.             page_size,
116.         }
117.     }
118. 
119.     ///
120.     /// # Description
121.     ///
122.     /// Checks if the present flag is set.
123.     ///
124.     /// # Returns
125.     ///
126.     /// `true` if the present flag is set, `false` otherwise.
127.     ///
128.     #[inline(always)]
129.     #[verus_spec(result =>
130.         ensures result == self@.present,
131.     )]
132.     pub fn is_present(&self) -> bool {
133.         matches!(self.present, PresentFlag::Present)
134.     }
135. 
136.     ///
137.     /// # Description
138.     ///
139.     /// Checks if the user flag is set (i.e., user-mode access is allowed).
140.     ///
141.     /// # Returns
142.     ///
143.     /// `true` if the user flag is set, `false` otherwise.
144.     ///
145.     #[inline(always)]
146.     pub fn is_user(&self) -> bool {
147.         matches!(self.user_supervisor, UserSupervisorFlag::User)
148.     }
149. 
150.     ///
151.     /// # Description
152.     ///
153.     /// Checks if the read/write flag is set (i.e., the page is writable).
154.     ///
155.     /// # Returns
156.     ///
157.     /// `true` if the page is writable, `false` otherwise.
158.     ///
159.     #[inline(always)]
160.     pub fn is_writable(&self) -> bool {
161.         matches!(self.read_write, ReadWriteFlag::ReadWrite)
162.     }
163. 
164.     ///
165.     /// # Description
166.     ///
167.     /// Sets read/write flag.
168.     ///
169.     /// # Parameters
170.     ///
171.     /// - `read_write`: The read/write flag.
172.     ///
173.     #[inline(always)]
174.     pub fn set_read_write(&mut self, read_write: ReadWriteFlag) {
175.         self.read_write = read_write;
176.     }
177. 
178.     ///
179.     /// # Description
180.     ///
181.     /// Sets user/supervisor flag.
182.     ///
183.     /// # Parameters
184.     ///
185.     /// - `user_supervisor`: The user/supervisor flag.
186.     ///
187.     #[inline(always)]
188.     pub fn set_user_supervisor(&mut self, user_supervisor: UserSupervisorFlag) {
189.         self.user_supervisor = user_supervisor;
190.     }
191. 
192.     ///
193.     /// # Description
194.     ///
195.     /// Checks if the page size flag is set (large page).
196.     ///
197.     /// # Returns
198.     ///
199.     /// `true` if the page size flag is set, `false` otherwise.
200.     ///
201.     #[inline(always)]
202.     pub fn is_large_page(&self) -> bool {
203.         matches!(self.page_size, PageSizeFlag::Large)
204.     }
205. 
206.     ///
207.     /// # Description
208.     ///
209.     /// Sets page size.
210.     ///
211.     /// # Parameters
212.     ///
213.     /// - `page_size`: The page size flag.
214.     ///
215.     #[inline(always)]
216.     pub fn set_page_size(&mut self, page_size: PageSizeFlag) {
217.         self.page_size = page_size;
218.     }
219. 
220.     ///
221.     /// # Description
222.     ///
223.     /// Constructs a [`PageDirectoryEntryFlags`] from a raw value.
224.     ///
225.     /// # Parameters
226.     ///
227.     /// - `value`: The raw value.
228.     ///
229.     /// # Returns
230.     ///
231.     /// A [`PageDirectoryEntryFlags`].
232.     ///
233.     fn from_raw_value(value: PteWord) -> Self {
234.         Self {
235.             present: PresentFlag::from_raw_value(value),
236.             read_write: ReadWriteFlag::from_raw_value(value),
237.             user_supervisor: UserSupervisorFlag::from_raw_value(value),
238.             page_write_through: PageWriteThroughFlag::from_raw_value(value),
239.             page_cache_disable: PageCacheDisableFlag::from_raw_value(value),
240.             accessed: AccessedFlag::from_raw_value(value),
241.             dirty: DirtyFlag::from_raw_value(value),
242.             page_size: PageSizeFlag::from_raw_value(value),
243.         }
244.     }
245. 
246.     ///
247.     /// # Description
248.     ///
249.     /// Converts a [`PageDirectoryEntryFlags`] into a raw value.
250.     ///
251.     /// # Returns
252.     ///
253.     /// The raw value.
254.     ///
255.     fn into_raw_value(self) -> PteWord {
256.         let mut value: PteWord = 0;
257. 
258.         value |= self.present.into_raw_value();
259.         value |= self.read_write.into_raw_value();
260.         value |= self.user_supervisor.into_raw_value();
261.         value |= self.page_write_through.into_raw_value();
262.         value |= self.page_cache_disable.into_raw_value();
263.         value |= self.accessed.into_raw_value();
264.         value |= self.dirty.into_raw_value();
265.         value |= self.page_size.into_raw_value();
266. 
267.         value
268.     }
269. }
270.

272. // Page Directory Entry
273. //==================================================================================================
274. 
275. ///
276. /// # Description
277. ///
278. /// A type that represents a page directory entry.
279. ///
280. #[verus_verify]
281. #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
282. pub struct PageDirectoryEntry {
283.     /// Flags.
284.     flags: PageDirectoryEntryFlags,
285.     /// Physical address of the page table (or large page).
286.     frame: FrameNumber,
287. }
288. 
289. impl PageDirectoryEntry {
290.     /// Size in bytes of the hardware page directory entry representation (32-bit encoded value).
291.     pub const SIZE: usize = ::core::mem::size_of::<PteWord>();
292. 
293.     ///
294.     /// # Description
295.     ///
296.     /// Constructs a [`PageDirectoryEntry`] with the given flags and frame number.
297.     ///
298.     /// # Parameters
299.     ///
300.     /// - `flags`: The flags.
301.     /// - `frame`: The frame number.
302.     ///
303.     /// # Returns
304.     ///
305.     /// A [`PageDirectoryEntry`].
306.     ///
307.     #[cfg_attr(verus_keep_ghost, allow(unused, verus_impl_method_marker))]
308.     #[verus_spec(result =>
309.         ensures
310.             result@ == spec_pde_new(flags@, frame@),
311.             result.inv(),
312.     )]
313.     pub fn new(flags: PageDirectoryEntryFlags, frame: FrameNumber) -> Self {
314.         proof! { use_type_invariant(frame); }
315.         Self { flags, frame }
316.     }
317. 
318.     ///
319.     /// # Description
320.     ///
321.     /// Constructs a [`PageDirectoryEntry`] from a raw 32-bit value.
322.     ///
323.     /// # Parameters
324.     ///
325.     /// - `value`: The raw value.
326.     ///
327.     /// # Returns
328.     ///
329.     /// - `Some(`[`PageDirectoryEntry`]`)`: If the raw value is valid.
330.     /// - `None`: Otherwise.
331.     ///
332.     pub fn from_raw_value(value: PteWord) -> Option<Self> {
333.         Some(Self {
334.             flags: PageDirectoryEntryFlags::from_raw_value(value),
335.             frame: FrameNumber::from_raw_value(value as usize >> crate::mem::FRAME_SHIFT)?,
336.         })
337.     }
338.

340.     /// # Description
341.     ///
342.     /// Converts a [`PageDirectoryEntry`] into a raw 32-bit value.
343.     ///
344.     /// # Returns
345.     ///
346.     /// The raw value.
347.     ///

349.         let mut value: PteWord = 0;
350. 
351.         value |= self.flags.into_raw_value();
352.         value |= (self.frame.into_raw_value() << crate::mem::FRAME_SHIFT) as PteWord;
353. 
354.         value
355.     }
